# Data Frames vs. Tibbles

- `data.frame` is base R
- `tibble` (tidyverse) keeps column types, friendly printing
- Converting: `as_tibble(df)`

---

# Live Demo Outline

```r
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

df <- read_csv("data/week1_sales.csv")
df %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(mean_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE))
```
